tools.name: Barcode Generator
tools.description: Generate various types of barcodes including QR codes, Code128, EAN, and more. Customize colors, sizes, transparencies, and export as PNG, JPEG, or SVG.

tools.name: JSON Utilities
tools.description: Clean, format, validate, and compare JSON data with a powerful editor. Features JSON repair, beautification, minification, and diff comparison.

tools.name: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate unique identifiers (UUIDs) instantly with customizable formats. Create single or multiple UUIDs with options for uppercase, lowercase, and dash formatting.

tools.name: Hash Generator
tools.description: Generate cryptographic hashes, checksums, and HMAC signatures using MD5, SHA, SHA-3, and HMAC algorithms. Features hash verification for data integrity and API authentication.

tools.name: Passphrase Generator
tools.description: Generate human memorable natural language or secure random passphrases with customizable options. Choose between memorable word combinations or cryptographically secure random strings.
